operations.evidence: The current contract, canonical HEAD 3d84363d742c5777dbc9aebf6749a546f57576ce, UNCLAIMED owner, sequence 38 checkpoint, same pickup_requested attempt and open H-to-F blocker were verified before writes.
A 15-minute lease was claimed only for official-source and line-by-line website evidence; runtime and business writes remained disabled.
Outcomes for offences recorded in a defined period were retained as a linked cohort that matures over time.
Early linked cohorts were not treated as final outcome distributions and cohort age was preserved.
Outcomes recorded in the year were separated from the year in which associated offences were recorded.
Outcome-to-offence rates above 100 percent were retained as illustrative cross-cohort rates, not true probabilities.
Outcome timeliness was retained as a possible efficiency proxy rather than a firm performance measure.
Administrative delay between operational action and system entry was separated from investigation duration.
Monthly force submissions and Home Office anomaly returns for validation or correction were recorded as separate QA stages.
The pre-publication exercise requiring every force to confirm Home Office-held data was preserved.
Home Office Data Hub record-level detail was classified separately from aggregated returns.
Crimsec4 monthly aggregate returns were retained as a distinct source with reduced linkage capability.
Crimsec4 outcomes were assigned to the month the outcome was applied.
Outcome-applied month was not equated with original offence month or year.
The five jurisdiction-transfer and cancellation reasons were preserved as separate categories.
Transferred or cancelled records were assigned to the financial year in which the action occurred.
The 64-character persistent_id was retained for cross-update crime identity.
The ordinary API crime id was not treated as stable or as an internal police identifier.
Specific-crime responses were retained as category-and-date case histories rather than latest-outcome fields.
Optional person_id presence or absence was not interpreted as outcome completeness.
Archive files were classified as complete point-in-time snapshots.
Older archives were not used as current-state data when Police.uk marks only the latest month for current use.
Published MD5 values were used only as transfer-integrity evidence, not source-truth assurance.
Street-level dataset months were required to appear in the availability endpoint.
Force identifiers supplying stop-search data were checked for each month.
An unavailable force-month was not converted into a zero count.
OA best-fit allocation was tied to the Census 2021 population-weighted centroid.
Whole-OA best fit was not substituted for exact parcel or boundary intersection.
National Park census estimates were retained as an explicit exact-fit exception to general OA best-fit policy.
Exact-fit and best-fit products were required to retain their distinct method metadata.
LSOA-to-MSOA-to-local-authority constraining was preserved as a hierarchy.
OA estimates were recognised as apportioned from and constrained to parent LSOA totals.
The IoD25 Crime Domain was pinned to eight composite indicators.
Burglary's at-risk-property denominator was kept separate from at-risk-population denominators.
Seven crime indicators' six-year windows were separated from the two-year ASB window.
Indicator values were retained as annual-average LSOA rates rather than current-month measures.
Shoplifting was excluded from the IoD theft indicator because of its shop-dependent and highly skewed distribution.
Broad Police.uk theft categories were not assumed to equal the IoD theft indicator.
Empirical-Bayes-style shrinkage was retained as a reliability adjustment for small LSOA counts.
Published Crime Domain scores were not represented as unadjusted raw local rates.
Non-uniform factor-analysis weights for the eight indicators were preserved.
Factor weights were not interpreted as causal parcel-risk coefficients.
The 10-metre boundary smoothing rule and reconciliation of raw geocoded counts against Home Office aggregates were recorded as production-specific QA.
